prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: Tretij Rebenok, the Third Child in MGSV The Phantom Pain 1984, faithful to Konami licensed Play Arts Kai figure. Small thin young boy with messy rust-red/auburn hair sweeping up in separated tufts, black heavy full gas mask with two dark round lenses and cylindrical central breathing filter. Glossy very dark charcoal leather straitjacket extending to upper thighs, multiple horizontal chest/waist leather straps and belts, very long empty restrained sleeves dangling down near knees. Dark tight leggings, ankle wraps and small bare toes. Child body proportions, NOT an adult soldier. No weapon, no helmet, no visible adult face. Floating psychic posture with both feet slightly off implied ground; no ground drawn. Row1: four restrained floating idle phases, head bowed slightly; mask oriented strict right. Row2: four rightward floating-motion phases with varied knees bending and long sleeves lagging, small body tilt; never a normal military walk. Row3: four psychic interaction phases lifting constrained arms slightly, sleeves swinging forward, pause, lower; no external particles. Row4: four recoil/recover phases hunching then straightening while still floating right-facing. Every frame retains auburn hair, mask, chest straps, long dangling sleeves, slender child limbs. Pure magenta background only, no glow, aura or detached marks. All parts fully contained.

notes: Child proportions, gas mask, auburn hair, long restrained sleeves, straps and floating posture retained.
Stylized small-scale pixel adaptation; no perfect likeness or smooth-motion claim.
